The Canon EOS R1 Mirrorless Camera allows any professional sports, news, or action photographer to shoot career-changing work with speed and advanced technologies at its core. The 24.2MP Full Frame Back-Illuminated Stacked CMOS Sensor along with the DIGIC Accelerator and DIGIC X Image Processor produces exceptional image quality, speed and low light performance.

Customisable continuous shooting speeds of up to 40fps allow you to capture fast-moving action. While the groundbreaking stacked sensor enables a 1/64000 sec top shutter speed with virtually no rolling-shutter distortion. 
Canon EOS R1 Mirrorless Camera is capable of shooting up to 6K video with frame rates of up to 60p using a wide variety of frame rates. Dual Shooting allows you to simultaneously capture 17MP (16:9) stills while shooting Full HD Video.

Image Stabilisation of up to 8.5-stops reduces the appearance of camera shake while shooting handheld or at lower shutter speeds in handheld positions. The 9.44m-dot electronic viewfinder (EVF) offers best-in-class performance with in-camera upscaling and noise reduction.

The camera has been redefined and surpasses on many levels, with a step-change in performance, cutting-edge image stabilisation technology, and next level video & image quality, being the ideal camera for professional photographers and filmmakers, as well as talented and artistic amateurs that have a strong creative drive.The Canon R5 camera will feature: 8K full sensor readout video capture; high-speed continuous shooting that will offer up to approximately 20 frames per second RAW image capture using the electronic shutter, or up to 12 using the mechanical shutter, and all 8K modes will support Canon's renowned Dual Pixel CMOS AF, as well as advanced animal AF that will recognise the eyes and body of dogs, cats, and birds; and advanced in-body image stabilization (IS) system of up to 8-stops and also works with existing IS systems on attached RF lenses; and dual media card slots and it will also support automatic transfer of image files from the device to the image, canon cloud platform.As mentioned, the Canon EOS R5 Mirrorless Camera definitely takes its video capabilities to the next level with 8K RAW internal video recording of up to 30 fps; and it can record 8K internal video up to 30 fps in 4:2:2 10-bit Canon Log (H.265)/ 4:2:2 10-bit HDR PQ (H.265); and also records 4K internal video up to 120 fps in 4:2:2 10-bit Canon Log (H.265)/ 4:2:2 10-bit HDR PQ (H.265). It's also capable of recording 4K external video of up to 60 fps; and something really exciting is that it doesn't crop in either 8K and 4K video capture while using the full-width of the sensor. Other features to this sophisticated Canon EOS R5 camera include Dual Pixel CMOS AF II that ensures an AF System that covers 100% horizontally and 100% vertically with Face + Tracking and Auto Selection modes; 100% horizontally and 90% vertically with manual selection and large zone modes; a large 3.15 Clear View Touchscreen LCD that features 100% coverage, anti-smudge, and reinforced glass incorporated; and an ISO sensitivity of 100-51200 (in 1/3-stop or 1 stop increments) and it can be expanded to a low of 50 and a high of 102400.

Name: Canon EOS R6 Mark III Mirrorless Camera Body
Description:
The Canon EOS R6 Mark III Mirrorless Camera offers the perfect balance between powerfull still performance and advanced filmmaking features, making it ideal for a wide variety of applications from sports, wildlife, weddings and even portraits.
With the Canon EOS R 6 MIII, you will experience the perfect balance between resolution, speed and reliability from the newly developed full frame CMOS sensor and DIGIC X Processor delivering 32.5 megapixels and up to 460fps continuous shooting to capture more details than its predecessor. You will also appreciate the expanded buffer, capable of handling up to 150 RAW images.
In terms of filmmaking, the EOS R6III records stunning 7K RAW Light footage up to 60p. For a slower and more dramatic result, it also supports 4K120p. Full HD 180 fps recording is also available for creative slow-motion effects.
The Canon R6 M III nests itself as your trusted companion, especially in high-paced environments such as weddings and sporting events with with improved tracking algorithms that effortlessly lock on to a moving subject and keep the subject sharp and in focus across the frame, these include trains, planes and horses. The Register People Priority function allows you to pre-select up to 10 faces for priority tracking.
Another notable upgrade from the predecessor, the Canon EOS R6 Mark III Mirrorless Camera, enables content to easily be repurposed across platforms with Open Gate. This feature captures the entire sensor's output to enable more flexibility in framing, stabilisation and post-production.
Excelling in low light, the Canon EOS R 6 M III Mirrorless Camera offers you an expansive ISO range of up to 64,000 for a clean and detailed image, even in challenging lighting conditions. For a comfortable handheld experience, you will appreciate the combined image stabilisation system providing up to 8.5 stops. 
The Canon EOS R6 Mark III Mirrorless Camera features multiple customisable controls along with a weather-resistant body design that makes this a camera designed to fit seamlessly into any creative workflow you through at it. Dual aspect markers frame for multiple platforms in one shot. To assist in better organisation and security, you find dual card slots supporting fast, high-capacity CFexpress Type B cards along with the widely used UHS-II SD card.

Name: Canon EOS R8 Mark II Mirrorless Camera
Description:
Meet the second generation in the EOS R8 line, the Canon EOS R8 Mark II Mirrorless Camera is a lightweight and portable full-frame powerhouse, bringing improved stability, speed and control.

Canon Log 3 adds grading flexibility, with up to 10-bit 4:2:2 recording and XF-HEVC S and XF-AVC S formats for hybrid workflows.

Description: The lightweight and compact telephoto Canon RF 100-400mm f/5.6-8 IS USM Lens is designed for the Canon EOS R Series, perfect for almost any application.
